value.syntax: # [doc = " Closed meanings of server failures under (´def:host:server-error´)."] # [derive (Clone , Copy , Debug , Eq , PartialEq)] pub enum Cause { # [doc = " A rule declared on the store (no duplicate, every reference present, every value within its declared check, no required value missing) refused a change."] ConstraintViolation , # [doc = " The request collided with other sessions' work at the same moment (a serialization failure or a deadlock)."] Conflict , # [doc = " A cancellation, or a time limit set on the server for a statement, a lock wait, an idle session or a transaction, stopped it."] Cancelled , # [doc = " An administrator ended the session, shut the server down, or dropped the database."] Terminated , # [doc = " The server is starting, stopping or recovering from a crash, or the connection to it failed."] Unavailable , # [doc = " The server ran out of disk space, memory or connections, or hit a configured limit."] Resources , # [doc = " The server is a standby, or set to accept only reads."] ReadOnly , # [doc = " The server refused the login: wrong password, or its access rules do not admit the role from this host."] LoginRejected , # [doc = " The role lacks a privilege the request needs."] PermissionDenied , # [doc = " A database, schema or role the configuration names is missing, or the server is not in the state the request needs."] Misconfigured , # [doc = " The server refused the host's own statement or a value it carried (a syntax, type, object, state or value error)."] StatementRejected , # [doc = " The server reported an internal or system failure, such as a disk read or write error."] ServerFault , # [doc = " The server found the stored data or an index physically damaged."] StorageDamaged , # [doc = " The server reported something this host does not know; every documented error class is mapped, while non-error classes 00, 01 and 02 also take this cause."] Unrecognized , }
